meta.title: Valley (joinvalley.co) clone: information architecture
meta.source: https://www.joinvalley.co/ (530 routes in the live sitemap)
meta.mirror: React clone in this folder, routes in src/App.jsx
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill; sections read from src/pages/**

categories.SHELL: Site chrome that frames a page: top nav, footer, and the fixed landing-page bar.
categories.HERO: The block that opens a page, above or at the fold.
categories.PROOF: Evidence from customers: logo grids, stories, testimonials, quotes, case teasers.
categories.PRODUCT: Blocks that explain what Valley does and how it works.
categories.COMPARISON: Valley set against competitors or against other ways of doing outbound.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks that ask for an action: plans, demo calendars, sign-up forms, FAQs next to a pitch.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial and long-form material: listings, article bodies, legal text.
categories.COMPANY: Blocks about Valley as a company rather than the product.

shell.navbar.description: Top navigation: logo, Home/Product dropdown/Case studies/Pricing/Blog links, Log in, and Start for free. Fixed by default; route-level props change only its load animation, stickiness and desktop breakpoint (see each template's chrome).

shell.footer.description: Site footer: sign-up and demo buttons, link columns, contact email and legal links.

shell.sticky-bar.description: Bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport with a short pitch and a demo button; hides on downward scroll, returns on upward scroll, desktop only.

hero.scene-cycler.description: Headline, two buttons and a product visual that autoplays five scenes (Find, Qualify, Research, Write, Send) every 5s, with a customer quote that changes per scene. /product renders a second copy variant of the same block.

hero.pricing.description: Pricing page heading and intro line, labels revealed on scroll.

hero.about.description: Full-bleed image hero on a dark teal ground with the company statement.

hero.landing-seo.description: SEO landing hero: eyebrow tag, headline, sub, two buttons, a rotating customer-proof ticker and a demo video.

hero.agency.description: Agency landing hero: restyled headline and sub aimed at lead-gen agencies, with a demo button.

hero.automation.description: Sky-image hero with an outlined label, a headline that blurs in word by word, two buttons, and four floating quote bubbles that cross-fade.

hero.contact-form.description: Opening demo-request form (name, work email, company) with a checklist; validates, then hands off to the external demo form.

hero.blog.description: Blog heading, email sign-up form and a featured-article card.

hero.casestudies.description: Case-studies heading and sub with an email form.

hero.post-header.description: Light-teal article header: title, subtitle and cover image.

hero.case-study.description: Dark case-study header: title and three headline stats.

hero.playbooks.description: Playbooks heading, intro and a product visual.

proof.logo-wall.description: Customer logo grid with a blinking-dot marker and quote tooltips on hover; a separate 'migrated from' layout below 1200px.

proof.customer-stories.description: Customer-stories carousel with its heading and sign-up button; slides advance every 7s.

proof.customer-stories-bare.description: The same customer-stories carousel without its heading, set inside a bordered frame.

proof.endorsement.description: Pinned full-height quote whose words fill in as you scroll; static below 600px wide or 650px tall.

proof.wall-of-love.description: Grid of customer quotes, photos and result metrics.

proof.logos-migrated.description: Logo grid of teams that moved to Valley from named competitor tools.
proof.logos-migrated.scope: All 4 routes on the SEO and agency landing templates.

proof.video-wall.description: Four customer video cards (click-to-play YouTube) that rise in on scroll.
proof.video-wall.scope: All 4 routes on the SEO and agency landing templates.

proof.case-banner.description: Single case-study banner whose star columns slide in on hover.
proof.case-banner.scope: All 4 routes on the SEO and agency landing templates.

proof.logo-cases.description: Logo grid where each logo opens a small case-study popup on hover.

proof.wall-ticker.description: Testimonial cards scrolling left at a constant 70px/s; paused while off-screen.

proof.case-bento.description: Bento of five customer case cards that invert to black on hover.

proof.quote-reveal.description: Pinned black stage where one customer quote reveals word by word as you scroll.

proof.video-testimonials.description: 'Hear it from them': four customer video cards.

proof.customer-logo-band.description: Band of customer logos under the case-study listing.

proof.case-testimonial.description: Customer testimonial with photo and a fixed CTA line, below the case-study header.

product.steps-walkthrough.description: Three-step walkthrough with a step nav that highlights the step in view.

product.jobs-stack.description: Pinned grid of 16 job tiles that fill as you scroll, with a price toggle and savings calculator.

product.showcase-tabs.description: Six product-app mockups behind tabs that autoplay every 6s; a click stops autoplay.

product.integrations.description: Integration hub diagram with click-only tabs.

product.team-fit.description: Tabs by team type (founders, sales teams, agencies), each with a pitch and a linked case study.

product.workflow-stack.description: Intro card followed by seven workflow cards that stack as you scroll on desktop.

product.feature-tiles.description: Row of feature tiles under the SEO landing hero.

product.problem-cards.description: Problem statement with three cards describing what breaks in current outbound.

product.agency-margin.description: Agency economics block: what Valley does to an agency's margin.

product.agency-workflow.description: How an agency runs client campaigns on Valley.

product.valley-magic.description: Calendar slider whose knob steps through four stops, revealing booked meetings; desktop only.

product.automation-features.description: Four feature cards, each with a looping Rive illustration.

product.automation-steps.description: Five step rows beside a Rive flow diagram that plays once when half visible.

product.automation-tabs.description: Five click-only product tabs (Dashboard, Warm Leads, Campaigns, Approvals, Inbox) over a screenshot frame; tab bar removed below 1200px.

comparison.full.description: Full competitor comparison: picker over 19 competitors, stage track diagram, legend, criteria, differences, pricing, side-by-side table, proof, directory and method.

comparison.compact.description: Compact comparison: picker and track diagram only, closing with a link to the full /compare page.

comparison.paths.description: Three paths to pipeline (hire, agency, Valley) compared on cost and outcome.

comparison.agency-paths.description: Agency version of the paths comparison.

conversion.plans.description: Plan cards with a Monthly/Quarterly price toggle.

conversion.studios-waitlist.description: 'Valley Studios' banner with a waitlist form that opens the external demo form.

conversion.pricing-calendar.description: Embedded HubSpot meetings calendar under a pricing heading.

conversion.demo-calendar.description: Embedded HubSpot meetings calendar closing the SEO landing page.

conversion.automation-calendar.description: Dark calendar section with the HubSpot meetings embed.

conversion.offer-faq.description: Pricing offer panel (plan summary and sign-up) beside the FAQ accordion.

conversion.faq.description: The FAQ accordion on its own, without the offer panel.

conversion.closing-cta.description: Closing work-email sign-up: rejects personal domains, then redirects to external sign-up.

conversion.waitlist-band.description: 'Join waitlist' band with a form and an animated inbox mockup.

conversion.case-faq.description: Case-study FAQ accordion; items open independently with a short spring.

conversion.playbook-cta.description: Call to action at the foot of the playbook library.

content.blog-card-grid.description: 'All blogs' card grid with Load More (+24 desktop, +6 tablet, +4 phone).

content.archive-list.description: Plain list of every post title linking to its article.

content.post-sidebar.description: Sticky sidebar: table of contents that highlights the section in view, and a 'Try Valley' form.

content.post-body.description: Author and dates, then three article sections with an inline CTA card after each. Body text is generated placeholder, not the live article.

content.case-grid.description: Grid of every case-study card with headline stats.

content.case-article.description: Challenges / Solutions / Results article with a pull quote and results stats, beside a sticky company card. Body text is placeholder.

content.legal-document.description: Legal page title and body in a centred column. Body text is placeholder.

content.playbook-categories.description: Six playbook category image tiles that filter the library.

content.playbook-library.description: Searchable grid of playbook cards with an empty state.

content.playbook-drawer.description: Right-hand drawer with one playbook's detail, opened from a card or a ?play= link.

company.mission.description: Mission letter beside an art card of hard-light shapes, with signature.

company.team.description: Two-column grid of team signature cells with LinkedIn links.

company.hiring.description: Hiring banner with 'Explore roles' and 'Contact us'.
